Kill [[Valis the Rampant]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Valis the Rampant]] in [[Twin Serpent Lakes (War in Kryta)|Twin Serpent Lakes]]
* *BONUS* Kill Valis the Rampant in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 3 [[War Supplies]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 1 War Supplies.

==Walkthrough==
This quest can be done with a [[hero]]/[[henchman|henchmen]] team (even though the hench will be level 15). It helps to bring your own healer, because the hench monk is probably not strong enough to keep your party alive.

Reaching Valis is easy, as there are only a few small groups of White Mantle along the way. Once you reach the target, take out the healers (priest and ritualists) first before taking down the rest of group.

It helps to bring plenty of anti-melee to help defend against each group's archers/warriors. [[Blind]]ing skills are especially useful.

Valis intercepts travelers and confiscates anything that interests him as a "tithe to the Unseen Ones." Those who resist Valis all meet a common fate. It is time to repay Valis the Rampant in a currency he understands: cold steel and magic! Those allies of Kryta who eliminate Valis will receive a royal bounty."''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch

In this utterly realistic historical reenactment, you'll earn a royal bounty by hunting down Valis the Rampant once again and making him pay for his misdeeds!"'''
